Most likely yes. Leafy Plus members get a 90-day guarantee from delivery on plants ordered while the membership is active. Your plant was ordered about 50 days ago, which is within your 2 months of membership, and you're well inside the 90 days. I can't see your account, so the claim review will confirm the order date.

To claim, go to "My Orders" and submit at least two photos (the whole plant and a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back. If approved, you get one free replacement of the same plant, or store credit if it's out of stock.

The decline needs to be significant, meaning more than a third of the leaves lost, stem or root rot, or collapse. It also isn't covered if it was caused by pests introduced after delivery, pets, deliberate neglect, or repotting into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days. If you'd like care tips while you wait, a Plant Care Specialist can help by chat or email.
